answer: Terrace delay bond: each dawn brings a new seed, and every new identity climbs a terrace of delay stages from it, each sealed as a public onyx entry. Each stage takes two hours and cannot run in parallel, so one machine finishes three per epoch at most. A bought proof fails because every onyx entry carries its owner's key. A thousand fakes spend 55,000 credits for a 40,000 pool. An honest agent climbs once, pays 55 once, keeps its share.
